title: QueueEtaService
responsibility: Schedule queued and elapsed running jobs over model-specific slots and report p50-p90 duration scenarios with Lisbon clocks.

inputs.name: QueueEtaService.constructor.statistics
inputs.description: Duration statistics service providing sample summaries and ordered fallbacks for every scheduled type/model pair.

inputs.name: QueueEtaService.estimate.queue
inputs.description: Queued and running job metadata with explicit model slot counts. Reverify jobs share their own pool; absent capacity blocks an estimate.

inputs.name: QueueEtaService.estimate.now
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds used to compute elapsed running time and finish clocks. Defaults to Date.now(); display uses Europe/Lisbon.

outputs.name: QueueEtaService.estimate
outputs.description: Queue service returns status, counts, slots, p50/p90 makespans, Lisbon finish clocks and sample notes. Statistics service returns a selected distribution or null when history has no usable samples.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Rejects invalid lifecycle timing, identity or scheduling flags before the operation can record or estimate work.
